description: This file defines the OAuth class used in PHPMailer for OAuth2 authentication. It handles OAuth token management, including obtaining access tokens and generating OAuth strings for authentication purposes.

classes.name: OAuth
classes.description: OAuth2 authentication wrapper class used by PHPMailer to handle OAuth token lifecycle and string generation for email authentication.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs the OAuth object with provider and user credentials.

methods.name: getToken
methods.description: Obtains a new access token from the provider using the refresh token.

methods.name: getOauth64
methods.description: Generates a base64-encoded OAuth token string for SMTP authentication.
